row:
DiscoverNEPA was created to highlight what makes Northeastern Pennsylvania such a great place to explore. From scenic trails and outdoor adventures to local eats, events and small businesses, it’s all about experiencing the best of NEPA.

Follow along for videos featuring local spots, regional guides and things to do throughout every season. Whether it’s a weekend getaway, a favorite restaurant or a new trail, there’s always something worth checking out.

Join the community, plan your next outing and share your experience with #DiscoverNEPA. Visit DiscoverNEPA.com to learn more.
